scope: Finite-lower ROWS and RANGE MIN/MAX over the shared admitted total-order scalar value families, with either finite or unbounded-following upper endpoints. Existing running, whole-partition and current-row ROWS suffix paths remain selected earlier.

public_interfaces.reason: Caller owns the queue and indices; original collector computes sorted RANGE boundaries and trims the retained tail.
Reuses production literal decoding and dependent nodes.
Preserves existing null, descending, saturated-bound and peer semantics.
Public indexed queue access; no private queue resource, buffer member layout or deprecated callable.
The admitted primitive/Decimal selectors match the total scalar ordering in AggrMin and AggrMax.
Charges std::vector storage before Reserve, including old plus new allocation; honors query memory limits.

invariants: Only a successful stream fetch increments the absolute input count; Yield does not produce output or change candidate state.
Queue base equals successful fetch count minus public queue size after each collector step.
All admission/expiry occurs in absolute row ordinals; index rebasing cannot change membership.
Each row enters each MIN/MAX deque at most once and leaves at most once; only non-null scalar values are retained.
An empty gap clears stale candidates and permanently retires rows before the new lower boundary.
Factory storage outlives its collectors; each stream value owns its queue, indices and candidate deques.
Finish and destruction release queue references and exactly the charged buffer capacity.
Only a window whose every output function is an admitted MIN/MAX aggregate bypasses the second collector. Native functions keep the existing final path.

optimization_quality.minmax_work: For each admitted output, at most N pushes, N removals and 2N value comparisons, plus N result rows. Collector boundary movement is monotone; row construction copies the existing row width.
optimization_quality.minmax_only_memory: One retained-frame/lookahead queue at its high-water capacity, plus at most one candidate per non-null active-frame row per admitted output. No additional whole-partition materialization is introduced.
optimization_quality.mixed_memory: The prepass queue plus the existing second collector queue coexist; both retain row references and the second stores modified output rows. Candidate storage is additional. The bound is the sum of the two high-water queue capacities and candidate populations, not one frame buffer.
optimization_quality.mixed_latency: With a following bound, the downstream collector needs future prepass outputs, which themselves need future original input. The key-space lookahead can approach twice the following bound plus peer closure and one-row end detection; no fixed row-count bound follows for dense peers.
optimization_quality.mixed_total_work: Remaining generic aggregate folds retain their original frame-scan cost; optimizing MIN/MAX alone does not establish whole-query asymptotic improvement if another aggregate dominates.
optimization_quality.peer_caveat: A finite RANGE frame can contain an entire partition of equal keys. Frame-dependent buffering can therefore reach partition size without an explicit partition-materialization operator.
optimization_quality.unbounded_following: The existing public collector must consume the partition before emitting the first result. MIN/MAX then inserts each retained row once and only expires candidates; ROWS initial filling likewise occurs once and its right endpoint no longer advances. This required drain can retain a full partition, and the mixed path can retain nearly two partition buffers.

scope_reassessment.source_implementation: All previously identified frame-shape gaps for admitted scalar MIN/MAX are addressed by this artifact plus existing specialized paths.
scope_reassessment.original_requirement: Q01 explicitly permits retaining the general path for functions requiring it.
scope_reassessment.remaining_fallbacks: Non-integer SUM, AVG and unsupported MIN/MAX value families retain the existing ordered fold. No claim is made that every excluded family inherently requires a fold.
scope_reassessment.acceptance: Implementation coverage can be reassessed independently of runtime verification. This report does not mark Q01 fixed or optimization quality verified.
